notes:
VDBackup v1.10

New
- Telegram: send backups to a private Telegram channel as unlimited cloud storage over MTProto - back up, restore and delete from the WebUI.
- RCS chats (Google Messages): a raw same-device backup plus a readable export that opens on any computer.

Interface
- The WebUI no longer freezes on a slow or unreachable connection; it stays navigable while icons load.
- Starting a restore without the data-replacement confirmation now explains what is needed instead of doing nothing.

Reliability
- Operations that cannot finish report the error instead of quietly reporting success.
- Per-app network-policy restore on custom ROMs now verifies the policy actually applied before reporting success.
